text:
Sam: Heads-up 
We keep seeing friction between SI PMs and Marketplace SDRs over lead ownership. Can we agree on an operational "claim orchestration" so people stop pinging each other?

Priya: Yes. Need simple rules: how long an SI can reserve a lead (soft reserve), when it becomes a legal owner (hard claim), and what to do when SFDC already shows an owner.

Luca: Suggestion: soft reserve = 48h by default, extendable to 7 days for strategic flagged deals (manual approval). Hard claim only after verified meeting or > $40k ARR.

Ava: Must also enforce source tagging on ingest (mp/aws, mp/azure, hw/partnerX, si/referral). This is the primary key for routing. If tag missing, auto-assign to SDR queue and ping ingest owner.

Sam: I want a single idempotent claim API so integrations don't race. Example flow:
```http
POST /api/v1/leads/{lead_id}/claims
{ "claimer": "si-77", "type": "soft", "ttl_hours": 48 }
200 -> { "lead_id": "L-2025-09-14-987", "status": "soft_reserved", "expires_at": "2025-09-16T10:12:00Z" }
409 -> { "lead_id": "L-2025-09-14-987", "status": "soft_reserved", "claimed_by": "si-21", "expires_at": "2025-09-15T12:00:00Z" }
```

Priya: For field mapping from partner CSVs/payloads, agreed minimal schema (must include one of email or company_id):
```
partner_csv_col -> platform_field
contact_email -> contact.email
contact_full_name -> contact.name
company_external_id -> account.external_id
account_name -> account.name
source_channel -> lead.source
est_value_usd -> opportunity.estimated_value_usd
partner_reference_id -> partner.meta.ref_id
```

IntegrationsBot: Ingest event: lead_id=L-2025-09-14-987, source=aws-marketplace, sku=RW-DED-XL, est_value=47000, partner_ref=aws-54321

Jun: Compensation question  what split applies for claimed co-sell? We need set rules so reps know if SI claims reduce their commission.

Ava: Current interim comp: SI success fee = 12% on first $75k ARR credited to SI, then 6% thereafter. For marketplace-introduced deals add a 2% marketplace bounty (if tracked). Final policy in partners/si-commission-v2 (RevOps to confirm).

Luca: Edge cases: duplicates and rapid-fire imports. Use an ingest dedupe key = partner_ref || (email || account_external_id). Intake system must return canonical lead_id and dedupe status. Also recommend a webhook subscription for claim events so SIs/Sales get realtime updates.

Priya: Security/ownership rule: if SFDC account.owner exists and their opportunity records show activity in last 90 days, deny SI hard-claim for opps <= $40k and notify both parties. For opps > $200k escalate to Sales Ops within 12h for an ownership arbitration.

Sam: Nice. Concrete action items:
- Priya: publish "claim orchestration" doc with exact API payloads and sample CSV (deadline: Tue COB).
- Ava: make source tag required in ingestion + implement 48h TTL default; flag manual extend flow (deadline: Tue COB).
- Jun: confirm comp percentages with RevOps and post final link (deadline: Mon EOD).
- Luca: spin up claim webhook prototype and dedupe behavior in staging; demo Thurs.

Sam: Please drop account ids/notes in-thread if you see exceptions (strategic logos, legal holds, mergers) so we can add them to the manual-exempt list. Thanks all, this should quiet the tug-of-war. :pray:
